run_libsize_check: run libsize.py on a .so file to display its size and compare against a saved baseline
run_libsize_baseline: run libsize.py with a new .so file and save file to establish a size baseline
run_libsize_compare: run libsize.py to compare current .so file size against a previously saved size and report the change
review_libsize_script: review the libsize.py script that reports .so file sizes and compares them to a saved baseline
refactor_libsize_script: refactor libsize.py to support additional output formats or multiple file comparisons
